brief: Hoo! Let’s step into Narnia one last time. In Chapter 17, Aslan crowns the four children at Cair Paravel. Build the crowning, then take a photo for your teacher.
mapday: No headset today? It’s Road Map Day. Read each clue and tap who it is about. Then finish two sentences about the end of the story.
extra: Add an Animated Deer for the White Stag. Say what happened when the kings and queens followed it.
step1: These are your five models. Say each name out loud. This list is also in VR, in the Canvas tab.
step2: Put on your headset and open the On-Demand app. Click Explore, type today’s map in Filter environments, and click it. Then click Begin Solo.
step3: Press the top button on your right controller and click Models. Put four chairs in a row. Put a crown on or by each chair. Put the lion in front of the thrones.
step4: Point to one throne and say this out loud. This throne is for… They were called the… because…
step5: Stand back so it all fits. Open your menu: Library, then Camera, then Take photo. Click the Canvas tab, pick this week’s VR assignment, and click Choose from My Files. Pick your photo, click Use this file, then Submit to Canvas. Look for the green Submitted tag. Then press the Meta button and click Quit.
